notes.title: ¡A Major New Update Has Just Arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello pilots
Before we start, we would like to apologize for the state of the game's release, with multiple bugs, design flaws and so on, in this new update we have listened to them and solved most of those bugs, mechanics and so on, especially the issue of Optimization in the gameplay was improved

Here's a full list of the changes in the update

1.- Improved render distance for better movement on the map
2.- Increased the number of bullets on pallet (this varies depending on your PC)
3.- Optimized RAM usage
4.- Bugs with adaptive music have been resolved
5.- Changed the SFX of all items, enemies, and more
6.- Added UI changes for better game immersion
7.- Dynamic Difficulty Optimization
8.- New songs were added to the repertoire
9.- New Visual Effects
10.- and more bugs fixed

Again we want to apologize, we continue to work hard to keep this game working and to be able to bring more video games, we hope they give us a new opportunity and we hope to see them on the battlefield. !Thank you!

GameWorks Interactive Team

notes.title: Version 3.0 is here! Look What's New In This Version
notes.notes:
Hello All Pilots.

We are sorry for the delay in the release of the new update and patch 3.0.
This Decision Was Made To Further Polish The New Mechanics, And Implementations That We Made In This New Update, As Well As The Correction Of Errors Found In The Course, This Update Fixes Most Of The Errors Of The Previous Versions (Including Some Things that were made on purpose), In addition to Implementing Visual Improvements, More Detailed Pixel Arts And Others, We Leave You The Complete List Of What Is Implemented In This Update

Implementation of New Mechanics: 
-Auto/manual trigger
-Auto/Manual Alternate Trigger
-Dynamic Difficulty
-New Temporary Damage Effects
-Critical Damage Chance
-Hit Box Visible (It's smaller than it looks)
-More Battlefield View

Audiovisual Improvements:
-Implementation of Pixel Perfect Camera 2D
-Dolby Atmos 7.1 Audio Implementation
-Optimization Of Objects, Enemies and bullets On Screen.
-Compatibility with AMD Freesync
-Detailed and Remastered Sprites
-Song Remastering

Extra Implementations:
-New Tutorial Added
-New Boss Added
-New Intro Added
-Insta Kill enemies
-New Balancing Of Enemies and Player

Note: In case of finding any error, report it through Steam, WhatsApp or Email to solve it immediately

 WhatsApp: 317 136 2793 (Support Available In Spanish, English,)
Mail: supportgameworksstudio@gmail.com (Support Available In All Languages)

 Thank you very much for the support, opinions and others, we will continue to constantly update this video game, greetings to the pilots and future pilots.

Atte: GameWorks Studio Latam

notes.title: ¡Important! This Monday, The New Update Arrives
notes.notes:
Hi Pilots.
We are aware that there are still problems within the video game
rest assured that we have resolved 90% of the bugs found.
In addition to that, we notify you that we have added new content to the game, that will improve the gameplay and optimization of the game.
now, let's clear something up.
Many people think that we are a group of 10 programmers, the answer is NO.
We are not many people, we are a studio of only 2 people.
we are dedicating ourselves %100 to our project.
Thank you very much for all the support, reviews and others, this Monday, the new version 3.0.0.2022 will be available.
We will not give spoilers
wait for it

notes.title: What's New In The New Version 2.15?
notes.notes:
What's New In The New Version 2.15?

-It To Enabled Partial Controller Compatibility
-The difficulty has been reduced.
-Added dynamic difficulty
-Remastered enemies.
-2 Original OST Songs Remastered.
Note: The Alternate Fire Fires The Weapon Of The Upgrades, while the normal fires regular and upgraded bullets.
-Added Player Hit Box Vision (Available when using Dash and Slowdown)
-Added 2 new bosses
      5.1: Hastur "the Unspeakable"
             5.2: The Virgo Dragon
Note 1: No one knows how to fight them
-Changed Sound Effects.
-Game Mechanics Modified
-Fixed bugs that made the game unplayable at certain points

Note: Playing With Control Does Not Modify Inverted Controls Of Distortion Zones.

Thank you very much for your support, reviews and others, we continue to improve this great game, greetings pilots

notes.title: What's New in Version 2.14
notes.notes:
The new update although a bit heavy, includes many new things

This is the complete list of improvements and changes: 

-2 New Boss Battles (Inspired by Lovecraft)
-The player control system has been improved.
-Problems with upgrades have been fixed.
-A new HUD has been implemented
-New Songs Have Been Included
-New Textures Were Added
-New SFX were added
-New Sprites Were Remastered
-The Optimization Has Been Improved
-The number of bullets on the screen has been increased.
-3 New Enemies Were Added, and Still More to Go
-Fixed Split Screen Issues
-New Cards Were Added To The Gallery
-New songs were added to the music player

Thank you all very much for your support and Critics, so we can continue to support this great video game

all this and more will be added to future versions of the game, Good Hunting pilots

¡Join Now For The Battle Of The Truth!

notes.title: Delay in the launch of the video game and the first version
notes.notes:
We are sorry for this unexpected delay. Since we really had thought that it would come out today in advance access.

However, we will take advantage of this to fix bugs and add more content.

Version 1.0 is now ready to be played
The First Version Will Include:

-Translation in 5 Languages
 *Spanish Latam
 *Spanish Spain
 *English
 *Chinese
 *Japanese

-Campaign Mode (1 Player)
-Extra Content

We will be giving updates constantly fixing bugs and adding more content

We also work on the multiplayer mode which will be disabled for now
we are very sorry for this delay, we would love for you to already have the game in your hands

It is also planned to release a free digital book that will be added in an update of the game, this for those who can better understand the history of the game

The game will be available these days without further delay

Greetings To All The Future Pilots of the Space Forces Wolfs.
